scope: Fixed target state from the cat content and common noise. Every 28-layer histogram includes all 4096x2048 values per target/B/A stream; spatial comparisons use 8x8 target pooling. Zero LoRA is only a 3B x 4A subset on the same custom route.
limits: Fixed anchor is an intervention, not full sampling trajectories or model success.
Paired references differ in subject, color and layout; A responses are not pure style.
Block outputs contain all previous residual updates; layerwise changes are cumulative.
8x8 averaging can hide fine detail; gray input padding may affect activations.
Histograms summarize all values only within the reported fixed range.
